name: Full-body pixel-art agent reference sheet
prompt: 32x32 pixel art sprite of a single Janissary sapper of the late 16th century, standing with tools in hand, rendered across eight compass-direction rotations, isolated on a transparent background, no environment. Male, late 20s, compact and heavily muscled through the arms and back from digging siege trenches, dust-grimed olive skin, a thick mustache with clean-shaven chin, close-cropped dark hair beneath a white felt börk stained grey with dried mortar dust, its brass kaşıklık holder dented from close work under fortress walls. Wearing a charcoal-grey kaftan trimmed in copper thread at the seams, sleeves rolled and tied back, a plain leather sash, dark şalvar trousers tucked into heavy boots built for mud and rubble. A short hand axe is tucked through the sash, an iron-shod digging shovel carried over one shoulder, a leather powder horn for laying mine charges slung crossbody, a yatağan at the hip for close defense when a tunnel is breached. Grime under the fingernails and a fresh scrape along one forearm. Expression focused, unbothered, the calm of a man used to working within earshot of the enemy. Bold, saturated period-appropriate color palette, thick clean black outlines for silhouette clarity at 32x32 resolution, minimal anti-aliasing, flattened simplified detail suited to the tiny canvas, no gradients, no soft shadows, consistent proportions across all eight rotations.
